nodes.text: Let $\delta>0$. If $n$ is sufficiently large and $G$ is a graph on $n$ vertices with no $K_{2,2,2}$ and at least $\delta n^2$ edges then $G$ contains an independent set of size $\gg_\delta n$.

#579 : [EHSS83] [Er90] [Er91] [Er93,p.340] graph theory | turan number A problem of Erdős, Hajnal, Sós, and Szemerédi, who could prove this is true for $\delta>1/8$. See also [533] and the entry in the graphs problem collection .
